summary: Python urllib's default redirect handler forwards an Authorization header to a redirected host. The shared GitHub Packages version-index reader now uses _RefuseFeedIndexRedirect: any redirect raises GateError before a redirected request or redirected version list can be accepted. Direct index reads and unreadable-feed refusals retain their existing behavior. This is distinct from .nupkg reads, which may redirect to Azure and use _StripAuthOnRedirect to remove authorization across hosts. The separate read-only coherent feed-readiness workflow uses this reader with contents:read and packages:read for a prospective version observation; it neither selects a release nor authorizes publication. Source and fixture establish the redirect and direct-read boundary. Current Actions-token package access and live feed state require separate operational readback.
title: Authenticated NuGet version indexes refuse redirects
